# GSA Manager Website

The marketing website for [GSA Manager](https://gsamanager.org), hosted on GitHub Pages using the [Just the Docs](https://just-the-docs.com/) Jekyll theme.

GSA Manager is an all-in-one business management application for associations, clubs, bookstores, and consignment shops. It includes point of sale, inventory management, CRM, checklist tracking, and integrated payment processing. It is a cloud-based SaaS application on the Microsoft Azure platform.

## Development

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec jekyll serve
```

[SAP Crystal Reports, Developer for Visual Studio Downloads](https://wiki.scn.sap.com/wiki/display/BOBJ/Crystal+Reports%2C+Developer+for+Visual+Studio+Downloads)
